content.text:
I stopped at step 2 of the skill: **`gh` authentication failed.**

**What happened:**

1. Ran the prescribed command against `shrujaya/test-repo`:
   ```sh
   gh issue list --repo shrujaya/test-repo --state open --limit 1000 \
     --search "sort:updated-desc" --json number,title,updatedAt > open_issues.json
   ```
   It exited with status 1 and returned:
   ```
   non-200 OK status code: 401 Unauthorized
   body: {"message": "Bad credentials", "status": "401"}
   ```
   `open_issues.json` was created but is empty (0 bytes) — no issue data was produced.

2. Confirmed the cause with `gh auth status`:
   ```
   github.com
     X Failed to log in to github.com using token (GH_TOKEN)
     - The token in GH_TOKEN is invalid.
   ```

This matches the step 2 stop condition (authentication error + no issue data), so per the skill I did not proceed to the pull-request check, the list-size check, or generating `issue_report.md`. **No report was created**, since producing one from zero retrieved issues would misrepresent the repository as having no open issues.

**To resolve:** supply a valid credential — either set a working token (`export GH_TOKEN=<valid token>`, needing `repo`/read access for `shrujaya/test-repo`) or run `gh auth login`. Once `gh auth status` reports a valid login, re-running the task from step 1 should complete the report.
